newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures tick downward, hit new day lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures tick downward, hit new day lows.

text.p: April 24 - U.S. debt futures ticked downward, set new day's lows. Futures brokers said turnover on the floor fairly light but picked up slightly on slippage just below Wednesday's low at 107-18/32. More critical support pegged at last Thursday's low of 107-14/32. They said cash dealers still seen looking to distribute 5-yr paper. March help wanted ad index fell to 87.
